doc.title: Mickey Roker interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Closing thanks
summary: Woods thanks Roker and closes the filming.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s beautiful. We have been filming here on location on the Royal Caribbean Cruise Line and we’ve been talking with Mickey Roker, a fabulous jazz drummer that’s played with many of the greats, and we are filming this jazz archive for Hamilton College. Thank you.
